name: Wishbone
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: the Storyteller points to one of them. If exactly one is good, they point to the good one.
flavor: Two people pull. One gets the wish. The other gets the argument.
otherNightReminder: The Wishbone chooses 2 players. Point to one of them: if exactly one is good, point to the good one; otherwise point to either.

name: Gravy Boat
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn how many evil players sit between you and them, counting the shorter way.
flavor: Pass it down to Aunt Carol. No, the other way. No, the OTHER other way.
firstNightReminder: The Gravy Boat chooses a player. Show how many evil players sit between them, counting the shorter way round.
otherNightReminder: The Gravy Boat chooses a player. Show how many evil players sit between them, counting the shorter way round.

name: Pop-Up Timer
ability: On night 3, you learn who the Demon is.
flavor: It's not done until it pops. Nobody touch the oven.
otherNightReminder: If it is night 3, wake the Pop-Up Timer and point to the Demon.

name: Hand Turkey
ability: You start knowing 5 players, and how many of them are evil.
flavor: Traced in second grade. Still on the fridge. Still watching.
firstNightReminder: Point to 5 players, marking them FINGER, then show how many of them are evil.

name: Carving Knife
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if you chose the Demon last night too, they die.
flavor: Measure twice, carve once. Or, in this family, accuse twice, carve once.
otherNightReminder: The Carving Knife chooses a player: mark them CARVED. If the Demon was CARVED last night too and is chosen again, the Demon dies. Remove last night's CARVED.

name: Antacid
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): they are sober and healthy until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: For when the third helping of stuffing starts talking back.
firstNightReminder: The Antacid chooses a player: mark them SETTLED.
otherNightReminder: The Antacid chooses a player: mark them SETTLED.

name: Cornucopia
ability: You start knowing how many Outsiders are in play, and who one of them is.
flavor: Overflowing with gourds nobody is going to eat.
firstNightReminder: Show the Cornucopia how many Outsiders are in play, then point to one of them and show their token.

name: Place Card
ability: You start knowing one of your neighbours' characters.
flavor: Someone spent an hour on the seating. You are next to Gary again.
firstNightReminder: Point to one of the Place Card's neighbours and show their character token.

name: Football
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players you haven't chosen before: you learn if they are on the same team.
flavor: Half the family is watching the game. The other half is picking sides.
otherNightReminder: The Football chooses 2 players not yet marked PICKED: mark them PICKED. Nod if they share an alignment, shake your head if not.

name: Meat Thermometer
ability: Each night*, choose a player: you learn if they are evil. Outsiders register as evil to you.
flavor: Stick it in the thickest part. Read it twice. Trust it once.
otherNightReminder: The Meat Thermometer chooses a player: thumbs down if they are evil or an Outsider, thumbs up if not.

name: Oven Mitt
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): if the Demon attacks them tonight, they survive, and you learn they were attacked.
flavor: Handles everything too hot for anyone else.
otherNightReminder: The Oven Mitt chooses a player: mark them MITT. If the Demon attacks them, they survive: wake the Oven Mitt and nod.

name: Thank-You Card
ability: Each day, you may privately thank a player (tell the Storyteller). Tonight, you learn their character, and they learn yours.
flavor: Thank you for the casserole. I know what you did.
otherNightReminder: If the Thank-You Card thanked a player today, mark them THANKED. Show the Thank-You Card their character, then wake that player and show them the Thank-You Card token, pointing to the Thank-You Card.

name: Recipe Card
ability: You start knowing a Minion character that is in play.
flavor: Grandma's stuffing. One ingredient is crossed out. One is underlined three times.
firstNightReminder: Show the Recipe Card a Minion token that is in play.

name: Gravy Stain
ability: Each night, you must choose a player (not yourself): until dusk, they register as evil.
flavor: It will never come out of that tablecloth. Or that reputation.
firstNightReminder: The Gravy Stain chooses a player: mark them STAINED.
otherNightReminder: The Gravy Stain chooses a player: mark them STAINED.

name: Folding Chair
ability: If a good player nominates you, you die.
flavor: Pulled out of the garage once a year. Do not lean back.

name: Burnt Turkey
ability: If you are executed, all good players are drunk tonight.
flavor: The smoke alarm has entered the chat.

name: Kids' Table
ability: You and your living neighbours register as Outsiders.
flavor: Folding legs, paper tablecloth, and a cousin who is twenty-six.

name: Tryptophan
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are drunk until dusk tomorrow, and they sleep through the night.
flavor: It's not the turkey. It's the four plates. But blame the turkey.
firstNightReminder: The Tryptophan chooses a player: mark them ASLEEP. They are drunk until dusk tomorrow, and do not wake tonight.
otherNightReminder: The Tryptophan chooses a player: mark them ASLEEP. They are drunk until dusk tomorrow, and do not wake tonight.

name: Food Critic
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their character, and they register as evil until dusk tomorrow.
flavor: Two stars. The cranberry sauce still had the can lines.
firstNightReminder: The Food Critic chooses a player: show their character token. Mark them REVIEWED.
otherNightReminder: The Food Critic chooses a player: show their character token. Mark them REVIEWED.

name: Decoy
ability: The first time the Demon would die, you die instead.
flavor: A wooden bird in the field, so the real one can slip away.

name: Seating Chart
ability: Each night, choose 2 living players: until dusk, they swap seats for every ability.
flavor: Nobody is sitting where the chart says. Nobody is admitting it.
firstNightReminder: The Seating Chart chooses 2 living players: mark them SWAPPED. Until dusk, abilities treat them as sitting in each other's seats.
otherNightReminder: The Seating Chart chooses 2 living players: mark them SWAPPED. Until dusk, abilities treat them as sitting in each other's seats.

name: Turkey
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The first time you are executed, you are pardoned and survive.
flavor: Every year one bird gets pardoned. This year, it's the wrong one.
otherNightReminder: The Turkey chooses a player: they die.

name: Black Friday
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. From night 4 onwards, choose 2 players instead.
flavor: Doors open at midnight. Prices aren't the only thing slashed.
otherNightReminder: Black Friday chooses a player: they die. From night 4 onwards, they choose 2 players.
